name: Ragas
description: Evaluates Retrieval Augmented Generation pipelines focusing on faithfulness context precision and answer relevance. Works without ground truth labels using LLM-as-judge approach.
best_for: Evaluating RAG retrieval precision and faithfulness, LLM-as-judge metrics
tags: evaluation ragas RAG benchmark testing metrics faithfulness retrieval

name: DeepEval
description: Unit testing framework for LLM metrics. Runs assertion-based pytest tests on accuracy bias toxicity hallucination and 14+ metrics. Best for engineering CI/CD integration.
best_for: LLM regression testing, CI/CD eval pipelines, automated quality gates
pricing_notes: Free open-source; Cloud from $99/month for teams
tags: evaluation deepeval pytest llm-testing quality ci-cd metrics bias toxicity

name: Promptfoo
description: CLI and API tool for evaluating prompt outputs against multiple models simultaneously. Enables rapid red-teaming and A/B testing of prompts across OpenAI Anthropic and open models.
best_for: Prompt A/B testing, model comparison, red-teaming, fast iteration
pricing_notes: Free CLI; Enterprise license for team features
tags: promptfoo evaluation prompt-testing model-comparison red-teaming cli a-b-testing

name: LangSmith
description: Observability and evaluation platform for LangChain and LangGraph applications. Provides tracing experiment management human-in-the-loop annotation and production debugging.
best_for: LangChain/LangGraph apps, trace debugging, production monitoring, human feedback
pricing_notes: Free for 5K traces/month; Developer $39/month; Plus $99/month; Enterprise contact sales
tags: langsmith langchain tracing evaluation observability production annotation

name: Braintrust
description: All-in-one platform for running LLM experiments managing datasets and evaluating AI apps. Provides a unified UI for experiment results regression testing and human review queues.
best_for: Experiment management, team eval collaboration, dataset management, A/B testing
pricing_notes: Free tier; Teams $500/month; Enterprise contact sales
tags: braintrust evaluation experiments datasets team collaboration llm testing

name: TruLens
description: Evaluation and observability library for LLM applications with focus on RAG pipelines. Supports real-time feedback logging using TruChain TruLlama and TruBasic wrappers.
best_for: RAG quality monitoring, real-time evaluation feedback, notebook-first eval workflow
pricing_notes: Free open-source; TruEra Enterprise adds production features
tags: trulens evaluation rag observability real-time feedback monitoring truchain

name: Arize Phoenix
description: Open-source LLM observability and evaluation platform. Provides traces embeddings clustering and automated evals for debugging and monitoring LLM and RAG applications in production.
best_for: LLM production debugging, trace visualization, embedding clustering, RAG evals
tags: arize phoenix observability tracing embeddings evaluation rag production debugging

name: Langfuse
description: Open-source LLM observability platform. Tracks costs latency quality and traces for LLM applications. Popular self-hosted alternative to LangSmith with SDKs for Python and TypeScript.
best_for: Self-hosted LLM observability, cost tracking, latency monitoring, team collaboration
pricing_notes: Free self-hosted; Cloud Hobby free; Pro $59/month; Enterprise contact
tags: langfuse observability tracing cost-tracking latency self-hosted open-source team

name: HELM
description: Holistic Evaluation of Language Models from Stanford. Comprehensive academic framework evaluating LLMs across accuracy calibration robustness fairness bias and efficiency dimensions.
best_for: Academic model benchmarking, safety research, LLM comparisons, holistic evaluation
tags: helm stanford benchmark evaluation holistic accuracy fairness bias safety research

name: EleutherAI lm-eval-harness
description: Standard open-source framework for evaluating language models on hundreds of academic tasks. Used by HuggingFace Open LLM Leaderboard as the backbone evaluation framework.
best_for: Model benchmarking on academic tasks, Open LLM Leaderboard evaluations, research
tags: lm-eval eleuther benchmark academic model-evaluation open-llm-leaderboard
